notes: ADE 6 replaces agent-to-agent orchestration with a durable event-sourced kernel; LLM sessions are disposable workers and never canonical workflow authorities.
Canonical workflow state is an external per-project hash-chained journal with disposable snapshots; corruption fails closed into SAFE_READ_ONLY.
Only the kernel creates worker sessions. v5 Managed Delegation code and ade_delegate are physically absent from the v6 runtime/tool registry.
Engineering DONE requires deterministic verification checks; WAITING_APPROVAL resumes persisted check progress without respawning the verifier or reusing consumed grants.
Exact-effect grants, VCS/tracker/process/Docker/secret hardening and scoped OpenCode Zen auto-only tool_choice compatibility are retained from the hardened v5 line.
Real Windows/OpenCode/provider validation remains pending and is not represented as completed release evidence.
ADE 6.0.1 removes wire-level max_output_tokens only from the observed ChatGPT/Codex responses route while preserving public OpenAI API generation budgets.

ade_workflow_start is a fast durable state transition only; it returns WORKFLOW_STARTED/workflow_id/next_action, /ade-workflow exposes active state, and the Orchestrator normally calls ade_workflow_run in the same turn.
ADE 6.0.2 dispatches newly created workers with steer delivery and accepts only an assistant-role response as worker evidence, preventing a queued capsule from producing false DONE.
ADE 6.0.3 explicitly registers ./plugins/ai-driven-engineering so OpenCode V2 builds that do not implicitly discover the managed package load its native tools.
ADE 6.0.4 adds plugin/index.ts, the root entrypoint required by OpenCode V2 beta-18721 for configured plugin directories.
ADE 6.0.5 captures the assistant result returned directly from session.prompt before consulting the asynchronously updated session context.
